meta.name: TapCash Aurora Token System
meta.generatedNote: Single source of truth for BOTH web (globals.css) and mobile (theme.ts). Run build.mjs to regenerate platform outputs.
meta.supersedes: TapCash Neon (v2.0.0, retracted same day it was locked) and Model U (v1.0.0). History: Model U (2026-08-05) -> TapCash Neon (2026-08-06 morning, built from Shayan's design-request reference app) -> retracted after Shayan saw the v6 mockup ('get rid of the neon vibe', 'still shows generic AI template', 'needs to be premium/high-end') -> Aurora (2026-08-06 evening), iterated through mockup v7 across ~10 rounds of direct feedback and confirmed as final. Do not revert to Neon or Model U without a fresh explicit decision from Shayan — this palette has already flipped twice.
decisionLog: 2026-08-06: 'Aurora' direction pitched and approved: obsidian + slow-drifting gradient-mesh atmosphere, one warm champagne-gold accent, no green/purple neon, no bounded card/box layout language (Shayan explicitly dislikes visible boxes/edges, including a box around hero art).

2026-08-06: Real assets over generated-vector placeholders confirmed as a hard requirement -- payment/gift-card logos are real official brand marks (fetched from official sources, not drawn), the mascot/piggy-bank/game-thumbnail imagery is generated art (not stock icons), and the wordmark got a real generated logomark, not a placeholder SVG.

2026-08-06: Glow is allowed on interactive/hero elements only (CTA hover, active states, hero art rim glow) -- REDESIGN_SPEC.md's blanket 'no ambient glow' anti-pattern is overridden for that scope, but 'no fabricated statistics' and 'no fake live-activity rows' stay in force. Any stats/live-count display must be wired to real data or not shipped.

2026-08-06: 'Alive' is delivered through real motion (breathing/idle animation, scroll-triggered reveals, hover-tilt, magnetic buttons, marquees, a state-change payoff animation on the piggy-bank motif) rather than ambient decoration -- see docs/superpowers/mockups/track2-mockup-notes.md v7 log for the full list validated in the mockup.

2026-08-06: Interac e-Transfer stays out of all sample/generated content per the separate, still-active Interac freeze decision -- unrelated to the palette change but touches the same generated files.
antiPatterns: No fabricated statistics — live data from /api/stats/platform or the surface doesn't render
No bounded card/box chrome as the default layout language — group content with spacing, soft shadow, and typography, not visible borders/panels
No generic vector-icon or stock-art stand-ins where a real asset (official brand logo, generated character/illustration) is expected
Glow reserved for interactive/hero elements tied to state or hierarchy — no ambient looping glow on purely static decoration

fonts.display: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif (weight 800, tight tracking) -- carries the premium feel via type scale/weight, not a specialty display face
fonts.body: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono -- currency/numeral values only, unchanged from the earlier decision, orthogonal to the palette swap

motion.marquee: 80000ms linear infinite (16-item game strip); 40000ms linear infinite reverse (11-item payment strip)

assetLibrary.note: Generated assets this palette introduced, kept as reusable brand assets going forward (not one-off mockup filler) -- regenerate in this same style/prompt family if new variants are needed.
assetLibrary.logoMark: docs/superpowers/mockups/assets/logo-mark (gold coin/arrow abstract mark, real alpha cutout)
assetLibrary.mascot: original 'dapper tycoon' character (top hat/monocle/cane) -- deliberately NOT a Monopoly likeness, see decisionLog in the mockup notes for the IP-safety reasoning
assetLibrary.piggyBank: intact + broken/bursting pair for the fill-to-break payoff animation
assetLibrary.gameThumbnails: 16 genre thumbnails for the offer marquee (originals: slots/tycoon/battle-ops/bingo; added: poker/racing/puzzle/soccer/strategy/fps/rpg/fishing/word/basketball/farm/battle-royale)
assetLibrary.paymentLogos: 11 real official brand marks (PayPal, Bitcoin, Mastercard, Amazon, Steam, Google Play, Apple, Xbox, Target, Walmart, Tim Hortons) fetched from official sources, not drawn

legacy.note: Retired palettes: TapCash Neon (v2, 2026-08-06), Model U (v1, 2026-08-05), and the original legacy palette (pre-audit). Any occurrence in platform outputs fails the drift test.
